name: ts-boilerplate
description: Operate a service built from ts-boilerplate over MCP: read and write its runtime state, and inspect what it is doing.

service_url.title: Service MCP endpoint
service_url.description: The deployment's MCP URL, for example https://your-domain.example/api/mcp

service_token.title: Service token
service_token.description: MCP_TOKEN from that deployment's .env. Stored in secure storage, never in settings.json.
